title: Questions 176-180 refer to the following memo and e-mail.
passage_1:
MEMORANDUM

To:All Employees
From:Tomas Kowal, Facilities Manager
Date:February 2
Subject:Stairwell Doors

To prevent visitors and delivery drivers from reaching the upper floors, card readers will be installed on the stairwell doors on February 8. To pass through a door, you will need to hold your employee ID badge against the reader. If the door does not open, simply press the “assist” button and ask a reception officer to open it for you. In that case, there is probably a fault with your ID badge, and it will have to be replaced. Once you reach your desk, please e-mail Ruth Okafor in human resources to request a new one.

Please contact me if you have any questions or concerns.

Tomas Kowal
Facilities Manager, Cairnwell Group

To:Ruth Okafor <r.okafor@cairnwell.com>
From:Ines Vidal <i.vidal@cairnwell.com>
Date:February 9
Subject:Request

Dear Ms. Okafor,

Following Mr. Kowal’s instructions, I am writing to let you know that I could not get through the stairwell door this morning without calling a reception officer. If possible, it would be helpful if you could deal with this before midday, as I am leaving early for my yearly physical. I have a meeting in a few minutes to welcome two colleagues who are joining the accounting team to help with the year-end audit, but I will be back at my desk by 11:00 A.M. if you need to reach me directly. My extension is 218. Thank you very much for your help with this.

Ines Vidal
Analyst, Cairnwell Group
